/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/husain-kiya-hai-namaz-kiya-hai.md')
original = p.read_bytes()
header, rest = original.split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
roman, source = rest.split(b'---\\n', 1)
header = header.replace(b'alternateTitle: \"Husain Kiya Hai Namaz Kiya Hai\"', b'alternateTitle: \"Husain Kya Hai, Namaaz Kya Hai\"')
verse = roman.decode()
for old, new in [
    ('kiya hai', 'kya hai'), ('hai namaz', 'hai, namaz'),
    ('mujhse', 'mujh se'), ('puchta', 'puchhta'), ('panjetan', 'Panjtan'),
    ('panjgana', 'panjgaana'), ('ijz', 'ajz'), ('inkisari', 'inkisaari'),
    ('shan fatehana', 'shaan-e-faatehaana'), ('hia', 'hai'),
    ('ibtida', 'ibtidaa'), ('pani', 'paani'), ('benayazi', 'beniyaazi'),
    ('intiha', 'intihaa'), ('inteha', 'intihaa'), ('taharat', 'tahaarat'),
    ('shaahkar-e-pak', 'shaahkaar-e-paak'), ('baarha ibadat', 'baarhaa ibaadat'),
    ('beriya', 'beriyaa'), ('Roshni', 'roshni'), ('chahti', 'chaahti'),
    ('shan-e-wehdat', 'shaan-e-wahdat'), ('piche', 'pichhe'),
    ('mustufa', 'Mustafa'), ('dosh per', 'dosh par'), ('bicha', 'bichha'),
    ('kibriya', 'kibriyaa'), ('ki talib', 'ki taalib'),
    ('zere sajud-e-ahmad', 'zer-e-sujud-e-Ahmad'),
    ('azam rakibana', 'azm-e-raakibaana'), ('iska', 'is ka'),
    ('zamana', 'zamaana'), ('bulati', 'bulaati'), ('baiyat', 'baiat'),
]:
    assert old in verse, old
    verse = verse.replace(old, new)
verse = re.sub(r'\\b(?:namaz|naamaz)\\b', 'namaaz', verse)
verse = re.sub(r'"'^  ([a-z])'"', lambda m: '  ' + m[1].upper(), verse, flags=re.M)
output = header + b'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + verse.encode() + b'---\\n' + source
p.write_bytes(output)
assert p.read_bytes().split(b'---\\n', 2)[2] == source
urdu_digits = str.maketrans('۱۲۳۴۵', '12345')
roman_lines = [line.strip() for line in verse.splitlines()]
source_lines = source.decode().strip('\\n').splitlines()
assert len(roman_lines) == len(source_lines)
for r, s in zip(roman_lines, source_lines):
    assert bool(r) == bool(s)
    if s.isdigit():
        assert r == s.translate(urdu_digits)
    assert all(c.isascii() or c == 'ṅ' for c in r)
print(sum(bool(r) and not r.isdigit() for r in roman_lines), 'aligned verses')
PY

git diff --stat -- src/data/lyrics/husain-kiya-hai-namaz-kiya-hai.md"

item.text: Audited all 42 Roman verses against the Urdu source. Corrected phonetic spellings, restored missing izafat, and changed `Kiya` to `Kya` in the Roman title and refrain. Verified alignment across the opening and all five stanzas. The Urdu text was preserved byte for byte.
